title: Ashwin gets a sponsor

nodes.speaker: Ashwin Chopra
nodes.text: Boss! I'm doing better, right?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Boss! I'm doing better, right?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I talked to Safia.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I talked to Safia.

nodes.speaker: Ashwin Chopra
nodes.text: And? What did she say.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And? What did she say.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: She thinks you are too young and naive.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She thinks you are too young and naive.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: She thinks you are too young and naive.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: She thinks you are too young and naive.

nodes.speaker: Ashwin Chopra
nodes.text: Oh... Oh right. Well, that's pretty clear cut then. Guess I'll just be alone forever!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh... Oh right. Well, that's pretty clear cut then. Guess I'll just be alone forever!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No Ashwin, you need to get over her.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No Ashwin, you need to get over her.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: No Ashwin, you need to get over her.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: No Ashwin, you need to get over her.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: She thinks you're a nice guy and she respects you, but doesn't want more than friendship.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She thinks you're a nice guy and she respects you, but doesn't want more than friendship.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: She thinks you're a nice guy and she respects you, but doesn't want more than friendship.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: She thinks you're a nice guy and she respects you, but doesn't want more than friendship.

nodes.speaker: Ashwin Chopra
nodes.text: Wow. I mean... maybe I just need to prove myself to her, you know? She already thinks that I'm a nice guy!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wow. I mean... maybe I just need to prove myself to her, you know? She already thinks that I'm a nice guy!

nodes.speaker: Ashwin Chopra
nodes.text: I'm in love boss. Haven't you ever been in love?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm in love boss. Haven't you ever been in love?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I get it, but she doesn't feel the same.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I get it, but she doesn't feel the same.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I get it, but she doesn't feel the same.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I get it, but she doesn't feel the same.

nodes.speaker: Ashwin Chopra
nodes.text: I know that. I know that you're right! But right now I can't help it. I can't think about anything else. It's like all the things that used to make me happy seem pointless.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I know that. I know that you're right! But right now I can't help it. I can't think about anything else. It's like all the things that used to make me happy seem pointless.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What things used to make you happy?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What things used to make you happy?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What things used to make you happy?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What things used to make you happy?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I have, and I didn't let it get in the way of doing my job.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have, and I didn't let it get in the way of doing my job.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I have, and I didn't let it get in the way of doing my job.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I have, and I didn't let it get in the way of doing my job.

nodes.speaker: Ashwin Chopra
nodes.text: Well I thought I had been in love before Safia, but I hadn't. She is different. The feeling is different.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well I thought I had been in love before Safia, but I hadn't. She is different. The feeling is different.

nodes.speaker: Ashwin Chopra
nodes.text: Well... my concept for the Restaurant Hygiene Technology company. I had this idea that my new start-up company would finally solve the issue of hygiene in Nivalis.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well... my concept for the Restaurant Hygiene Technology company. I had this idea that my new start-up company would finally solve the issue of hygiene in Nivalis.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds great!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds great!

nodes.speaker: Ashwin Chopra
nodes.text: Right!? A problem as old as gastronomy itself! And I was going to solve it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right!? A problem as old as gastronomy itself! And I was going to solve it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: If it sounded promising I might even invest in your hygiene business.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If it sounded promising I might even invest in your hygiene business.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: If it sounded promising I might even invest in your hygiene business.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: If it sounded promising I might even invest in your hygiene business.

nodes.speaker: Ashwin Chopra
nodes.text: Really? Well, I guess I could look at the old business plan documents again... Would you really be interested?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Really? Well, I guess I could look at the old business plan documents again... Would you really be interested?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe. But I mainly want you working again.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe. But I mainly want you working again.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Maybe. But I mainly want you working again.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Maybe. But I mainly want you working again.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sure. This could actually really help out the business.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure. This could actually really help out the business.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Sure. This could actually really help out the business.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Sure. This could actually really help out the business.

nodes.speaker: Ashwin Chopra
nodes.text: Right... Nice!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right... Nice!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So no more distractions at work?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So no more distractions at work?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So no more distractions at work?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So no more distractions at work?

nodes.speaker: Ashwin Chopra
nodes.text: I hear you boss.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I hear you boss.

nodes.speaker: Ashwin Chopra
nodes.text: You got it boss.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You got it boss.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: If you have some proposals, let me know.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If you have some proposals, let me know.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: If you have some proposals, let me know.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: If you have some proposals, let me know.

nodes.speaker: Ashwin Chopra
nodes.text: Deal!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Deal!

nodes.speaker: Ashwin Chopra
nodes.text: Of what? You firing me? Damn... I actually didn't see that coming...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Of what? You firing me? Damn... I actually didn't see that coming...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Really? That's your dream?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Really? That's your dream?

nodes.speaker: Ashwin Chopra
nodes.text: Well, it was. But right now it's Safia.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, it was. But right now it's Safia.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: She says there's no chance you two will ever get together.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She says there's no chance you two will ever get together.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: She says there's no chance you two will ever get together.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: She says there's no chance you two will ever get together.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I would like to hear more.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I would like to hear more.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I would like to hear more.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I would like to hear more.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: This is a terrible idea Ashwin. I think it's better we part ways.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This is a terrible idea Ashwin. I think it's better we part ways.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: This is a terrible idea Ashwin. I think it's better we part ways.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: This is a terrible idea Ashwin. I think it's better we part ways.
